title: Global Workplace AI Engineer
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
We’re building a network of smart, helpful Copilot powered agents that make it easier for our colleagues in ING to get things done. M365 Copilot & Copilot Studio and Power Platform are at the heart of this. We’re looking for a developer who can help us scale our agentic AI capabilities across ING, starting with IT and HR support agents, and expanding into other domains across ING like Finance and Operations. You’ll work closely with product owners, designers, and domain experts to build, test, and improve conversational agents that are intuitive, accessible, and genuinely useful.
Design and implementCopilot Studio agentsusing best practices for modularity, intent routing, fallback handling, and escalation (to humans or systems).
Build and maintainadaptive card flowsfor troubleshooting, knowledge lookups, and ticketing — with a focus on accessibility, localisation, and user feedback.
Integrate withServiceNowand other backend systems to enable seamless, pre-filled ticket creation and status updates.
Applyknowledge management principlesto ensure content is accessible, relevant, and easy to maintain — including support for media like images and videos.
Collaborate onmeasurement strategiesthat go beyond star ratings — helping us capture meaningful feedback and improve continuously.
Championaccessibilityin everything you build — including keyboard-first navigation, screen reader support, and speech-to-text/text-to-speech capabilities.
Contribute to ascalable agent architecturethat supports phased rollouts, learning loops, and future growth across ING.
Prompt Design Expertise:Experience crafting, refining, and evaluating prompts for GenAI agents, chatbots, or Copilot Studio.
Proven experience withMicrosoft Copilot Studio(or Power Virtual Agents)
Strong knowledge of M365, EntraID, Azure AD andPower Platform.Power Automate(for backend flows and integrations)Power Apps(for internal tooling and UI extensions)
Power Automate(for backend flows and integrations)
Power Apps(for internal tooling and UI extensions)
Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft 365 security principles and controls.
Proficiency in:Microsoft GraphYAML and PythonHTML/CSSJSON(for adaptive cards and data handling)
JSON(for adaptive cards and data handling)
Familiarity withAPIs and integration patterns
Understanding ofaccessibility standards(WCAG) and localisation best practices
Experience withAzure Bot Framework,Dataverse
Knowledge ofCI/CD pipelinesfor Power Platform
Background inUX writingor conversational design
JavaScript/TypeScript
What We’re Looking For
You’re a builder — you like to ship things that work and make people’s lives easier.
You’re pragmatic — you know when to go fast and when to slow down.
You’re collaborative — you work well with designers, product owners, and business stakeholders.
You’re a self-starter – you take the initiative and get things done.
You care about the details — especially when it comes to accessibility and user experience.
Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ING we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
